svg.title: Multi-Raft on Cell Groups
svg.desc: Each colored row is a separate Raft group with one leader and two followers. Every replica contains the same individual cell SQLite databases. Leaders differ between groups. Replication arrows connect each leader directly to both followers through spacious routing lanes. Node workers, log storage and SQL pools are shared.
svg.text: Many cells share one Raft group. Independent groups share the same nodes.
GROUP 2 · leader B → followers A + C
